newsitem.title: USA: Safety 1st signs new credit line pact.
newsitem.headline: Safety 1st signs new credit line pact.

text.p: Safety 1st Inc said on Tuesday it entered into a $45 million secured credit facility through Goldman Sachs Credit Partners LP, replacing a previous loan agreement.
The facility was comprised of a $25 million term loan and a $20 million revolving credit facility, the company said. Both facilities expire May 1, 1998, it said.
The interest rate would be prime plus 2.65 percent for the initial six months and would increase by one percentage point every three months after that, it said.
Safety 1st said it might issue warrants in conjunction with the new credit facility.
The company also said it continued to work with Goldman, Sachs & Co to explore various alternatives to enhance shareholder value.
Safety 1st develops, markets and distributes child care products, including feeding, teething, health-hygiene and convenience items as well as a line of home security products.
